headline: 2027 French presidential election: Parties torn between internal rivalry and unity against radical options
description: Given the electoral momentum of the far right and radical left, the prospect of a single candidate is now a pressing question on the left, centrist and right-wing blocs. Moderate voters may be tempted to cast a strategic vote in the first round for the candidate most likely to prevent a dreaded runoff between Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

description: France's National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies released worrying figures that confirmed economic troubles for the country. Growth has stalled, inflation is rising, purchasing power is falling and employment is weakening.

headline: Tibet landslide undermines Xi Jinping's gamble on the Himalayas
description: The devastated Gyirong border post stands at the heart of China's strategy for south Asia. A railway line, set to become a key link in the Belt and Road Initiative, is planned to pass through here.

headline: Iceland's rejection of EU accession talks seen as 'setback' in Brussels
description: European leaders gave a reserved response after Iceland voted against resuming accession talks, a result welcomed by far-right Euroskeptic parties.

headline: 'No regulation exists:' Suez Canal becomes gateway for invasive species in the Mediterranean
description: 'Suez, a historic canal' (6/6). The opening of a passage between the Red Sea and the Mediterranean led to migrations of 'Lessepsian' species, named after the canal's developer, Ferdinand de Lesseps. Their proliferation, which destabilizes ecosystems, has increased due to overfishing, pollution, coastal building and climate change.

headline: Will this summer's climate disasters push French politicians and citizens to act?
description: Heatwaves, wildfires and droughts, all intensified by climate change, do not lead to shifts in public attitudes without strong political will. Still, a sense of a need for protection and concrete measures is emerging.
